title: Chikusetsusaponin IVa improves osseointegration by inhibiting osteoblast ferroptosis via the GSK3beta/NRF2/GPX4 pathway.
authors: Yang, Yunshang; Jiang, Yifan; Qian, Daoyi; Qiang, Zhiyuan; Xia, Donglong; Yu, Jingxian; Dong, Minyi; Tang, Cheng; Geng, Dechun; Xiao, Long; Zhu, Like; Ni, Chunlin; Li, Yajun; Wang, Zhirong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物CHS IVa通过GSK3beta/NRF2/GPX4通路抑制成骨细胞铁死亡改善骨整合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoporosis-induced implant loosening can lead to surgical failure and impede patient recovery. Various approaches, including anti-osteoporosis drugs, have been explored to improve implant stability, however, they fail to improve bone formation or restore bone balance, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic strategies. Certain natural products, such as Chikusetsusaponin IVa (CHSs IVa) exhibit strong antioxidant and bone-protective properties, making them viable options for improving implant stability. This study aims to investigate the inhibitory effect of CHS IVa on ferroptosis and its potential to restore bone formation in bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and mouse embryonic osteoblast precursor cells (MC3T3-E1). By mitigating ferroptosis, CHS IVa increases bone mass and promotes bone integration, improving implant stability. Using a rat model of implant loosening under osteoporosis, we conducted morphological analysis, bone microstructure assessment, on tissue surrounding the implants. In vitro experiments and phosphorylated antibody chip experiments combined with molecular docking were employed to investigate the inhibitory mechanism of CHS IVa. Our findings reveal that ferroptosis occurs around internal implants under osteoporotic conditions. CHS IVa inhibits ferroptosis in osteoblasts by intervening in the GSK3beta/NRF2/GPX4 pathway, saving osteoblasts osteogenic ability and increasing bone mass at the implant bone interface, further enhancing implant stability.
abstract_zh: 骨质疏松引起的植入物松动可导致手术失败并阻碍患者康复。为改善植入物稳定性，已探索了多种方法，包括抗骨质疏松药物，然而这些方法未能改善骨形成或恢复骨平衡，凸显了对新型治疗策略的需求。某些天然产物，如竹节参皂苷IVa (Chikusetsusaponin IVa, CHS IVa)，表现出强效的抗氧化和骨保护特性，使其成为改善植入物稳定性的可行选择。本研究旨在探讨CHS IVa对铁死亡 (ferroptosis) 的抑制作用及其在骨髓间充质干细胞 (bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, BMSCs) 和小鼠胚胎成骨前体细胞 (MC3T3-E1) 中恢复骨形成的潜力。通过减轻铁死亡，CHS IVa增加骨量并促进骨整合，从而改善植入物稳定性。利用骨质疏松条件下植入物松动的大鼠模型，我们对植入物周围组织进行了形态学分析和骨微结构评估。采用体外实验和磷酸化抗体芯片实验结合分子对接 (molecular docking)，以研究CHS IVa的抑制机制。我们的研究结果表明，在骨质疏松条件下，内部植入物周围发生铁死亡。CHS IVa通过干预GSK3beta/NRF2/GPX4通路抑制成骨细胞铁死亡，挽救成骨细胞的成骨能力并增加植入物-骨界面的骨量，进一步增强植入物稳定性。
